title: Aftercare: Stability Harvest, Synthetic Safety Suite & Fallback Orchestration
creator: Maya Chen
body:
Summary:
We suffered a partial canary degradation on 2026-03-08 during the runtime-2.4 model swap. Traffic skew triggered a tail-latency amplification in the canary shard and a small fraction of requests experienced token-level timeouts and semantic regressions. This ticket bundles the postmortem follow-ups: new 'stability-harvest' artifacts, an automated Synthetic Safety Suite for rapid post-rollout validation, and a fallback orchestration blueprint to reduce blast radius for future rollouts.

Problem statement and scope:
- Root cause (investigation notes): a combination of cross-tenant KV-cache churn and an atypical distribution of long-context requests exposed a kernel scheduling regression for our quantized variant (see telemetry link).
- Scope of follow-ups: changes to runbook automation, telemetry contracts for canary vs shadow parity, lightweight synthetic litmus tests to run automatically post-promotion, and a fallback orchestration policy that can steer 100% of traffic to safe variants within 60s.

Goals / Acceptance criteria:
1) Stability harvest pipeline implemented: within 30 minutes of a canary anomaly, we must capture 1k representative request traces, diffs of KV cache state, and top-200 failure prompts into an S3 bucket for forensic analysis. (Verify: s3://redwood-rollout-harvest/2026-03-08-774201)
2) Synthetic Safety Suite: run a 200-case adversarial + long-context probe against promoted model within the first 10 minutes; gating fails if >2% semantic regression or >0.5% hallucination score.
3) Fallback orchestration: ability to switch routing policy to fallback variant or to degrade features (disable streaming, enable shorter context) with automated alerting and a rollback ticket created. Execution target: TTR (time-to-redirect) <= 60s and TTR <= 3s for local control-plane actions.
4) Runbook updates: play-by-play for SRE + oncall + Eng owner mapping, and a checklist in Console (rollouts > postmortem > stability-harvest) that can be executed by PMs.

Planned steps:
A. Implementation (owners):
  - Stability harvest collector (Arjun P., Eng Infra): new lambda that subscribes to canary-alert webhooks, snapshots required telemetry, and writes artifact bundle.
  - Synthetic Safety Suite (Maya C., Applied ML + QA): a small python harness (pytest-compatible) with 200 probes generated from historical failure prompts, plus fuzzed long-history prompts. Harness runs via CI job triggered by promotion.
  - Fallback orchestration (SRE team): extend the routing-controller with a fallback action that first tries region-local model downgrade, then full-redirect to a known-safe variant (quantized-v1.9-safe).
  - Runbook codification (Docs): convert notes into a 6-step interactive checklist in Console with links to artifacts and K/D thresholds.

Telemetry & Metrics to add:
- canary:latency_95, canary:token_err_rate, canary:model_regression_score (derived), KV:eviction_rate, route:redirect_time_ms, harvest:artifact_size_bytes
- New histograms for synthetic-suite results: synthetic:hallucination_rate, synthetic:semantic-delta

Gating thresholds (proposal):
- If canary:latency_95 > baseline_95 + 30% for 3 consecutive 1m windows => mark 'critical' and trigger fallback orchestration.
- If model_regression_score > 2% on synthetic-suite within 10 minutes => immediate traffic freeze and manual triage.

Risk and trade-offs:
- Synthetic Suite increases promotion latency (~45-90s). Trade-off: stronger early detection at cost of small delay; we will gate by rollout policy and allow opt-out for urgent patches.
- Fallback orchestration complexity: adds routing code paths and potential oscillation. Mitigation: add hysteresis and 5-minute cooldowns, record state transitions in audit logs.

Testing plan:
- Unit tests for harvest lambda and synthetic harness.
- Integration test in staging: run full promotion workflow with synthetic-suite turned on; inject simulated KV churn using chaos job (ENG-741002).
- Run a dry-run canary in 'shadow' mode attached to live traffic for 24h; verify telemetry contract parity.

Runbook / Playbook excerpt (to be added to Console checklist):
1) On canary-alert: click stability-harvest -> collect artifacts -> mark oncall and assign Eng owner.
2) Run synthetic-suite job link; observe scores. If hallucination_rate > 0.5% OR semantic-delta > 2% -> execute fallback orchestration.
3) Fallback orchestration steps: (a) pause promotion; (b) redirect 70% traffic to safe variant; (c) escalate to PM + model owner; (d) open rollback PR if necessary.
4) Post-action: open postmortem ticket, attach harvest artifact bundle, and schedule 1-hour blameless review.

Deliverables:
- stability-harvest lambda + test coverage
- synthetic-safety-suite repo + CI job
- routing-controller fallback implementation + telemetry hooks
- Console checklist and runbook update doc + audit log hookup

Notes and links to artifacts:
- Telemetry dashboard (staging): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/stability/canary-774201
- Forensic S3 bundle (sample): s3://redwood-rollout-harvest/2026-03-08-774201/manifest.json
- Investigation notes (Confluence): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/774201-rollout-harvest

Open questions (to resolve in first week):
- Exact semantic-delta calculation: should we use BLEU-like metric or model-based entailment scorer? (Assigned to Maya for evaluation)
- Promotion latency SLO tradeoff: allow synthetic-suite opt-out for emergency promotes? (PM decision required)

2026-03-11 - Arjun Patel: Implemented harvest lambda prototype; pushing PR for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1892
2026-03-12 - SRE Lead (Hannah Li): Verified webhook resiliency; added retries and idempotency to collector. Observed artifact size ~1.6MB for 1k traces.
2026-03-12 - QA (Diego Ramos): Synthetic harness v0 added to ci/safety; running tests in staging now (results expected 2026-03-14).
2026-03-13 - PM (Lara O'Neill): Agreed to P1 priority and to include fallback orchestration in runtime-2.4 patch. We still need to finalize the semantic metric by end of week.
2026-03-14 - Arjun Patel: Drafted fallback orchestration flow; added 60s redirect target and 5-minute cooldown hysteresis. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/710
retrospective_actions: Add synthetic-suite to promotion pipeline with an opt-out override and documented PM approval path.
Add canary parity contract tests: ensure telemetry fields exist in shadow and canary modes.
Create a quarterly calibration task for synthetic probes (refresh dataset every quarter).
Instrument routing-controller to emit state-change audit logs for fallback transitions.
Schedule a 90-minute cross-functional debrief and update rollout runbook based on today's learnings.
